def factor_ts_size_adaptive_value(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    # Time-series rolling percentile of mkt_cap_float (own history)
    size_pct = df_copy['mkt_cap_float'].rolling(252, min_periods=60).rank(pct=True)
    # Earnings yield (safe inverse)
    earn_yield = 1.0 / df_copy['pe_ttm'].replace(0, np.nan)
    # Book yield with leverage penalty
    book_yield = 1.0 / df_copy['pb_lf'].replace(0, np.nan)
    debt_ratio = df_copy['debttoassets'] / 100.0
    leverage_penalty = (1.0 - debt_ratio).clip(lower=0.0)
    book_yield_adj = book_yield * leverage_penalty
    # Conditions: large relative own history (>70th pct) use earn_yield; small (<30th pct) use book_yield_adj; else average
    large = size_pct > 0.7
    small = size_pct < 0.3
    avg = (earn_yield + book_yield_adj) / 2.0
    factor = np.select([large, small], [earn_yield, book_yield_adj], default=avg)
    df_copy['factor_ts_size_adaptive_value'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_ts_size_adaptive_value']
